lessons.trigger_condition: a fresh protected static-data candidate based on main 3af7e77fd74af46ce5b82289100b8763a025de6f updates grading_company_updates.json after v351, while the v351 regression still requires zero later watched-path changes even when an exact successor generation is bundled
lessons.prevention_rule: keep watched-path fail-closed behavior, but allow a historical generation regression to delegate only to a strictly newer verified contract whose exact base, exact watched-path set, generation files, digest, receipt, and source ancestry all validate; the current v352 candidate remains limited to grading_company_updates.json

the only newly changed watched path is grading_company_updates.json
v352 generation files are bundled in the same protected-main PR and exactly match the candidate contract
